title: Rork Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Rork builds genuinely native mobile apps, but it falls short on backend depth, its free tier, and pricing for the full Apple device family. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Rork's three biggest gaps natively, real builds from the free tier instead of design-only, a database and auth included instead of bring-your-own, and one flat price instead of a $200/mo jump for the full Apple device family, and it's a more complete platform overall: native billing, a customer-facing AI gateway, and built-in growth tooling are all things Rork doesn't offer at any tier. More options are listed in our[Rork alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/rork-alternatives) roundup.
